connections.purpose: Receive customer purchase orders and attachments
connections.preferred: Gmail API + users.watch via Google Cloud Pub/Sub
connections.fallback: Export the message as JSON and ingest it with the CLI

connections.purpose: Canonical customers, sales orders, items, prices, discounts, and order status
connections.preferred: SuiteTalk REST Record Service + SuiteQL using OAuth 2.0
connections.fallback: Export approved saved-search CSV/JSON and plan actions locally; never silently write back

connections.purpose: Capture special warehouse-handling requests after order interpretation
connections.preferred: Typeform MCP for form administration/analysis; REST API + webhooks for responses
connections.fallback: Generate an auditable warehouse-request payload for a human to submit
limitations: The supported APIs do not submit a response as if they were a respondent

connections.purpose: Track warehouse request ownership, status, and exceptions
connections.preferred: Wrike API v4 + webhooks using OAuth 2.0
connections.fallback: Create and complete equivalent tasks in the local workflow ledger

connections.purpose: Fulfillment, inventory, deliberate automation hold/release, shipment, BOL, and tracking
connections.preferred: STORD-approved API, EDI, SuiteApp, SFTP, or HTTPS contract for the Blume account
connections.fallback: Generate hold/release/BOL tasks and require human evidence before completion
limitations: No authoritative public Blume-specific hold/release endpoints were found

connections.purpose: Human-facing queue, audit view, evidence documents, and meeting reporting
connections.preferred: Google Sheets API + Drive API using OAuth 2.0 or a file-shared service account
connections.fallback: Export the workflow ledger as JSON/CSV

connections.purpose: Private application runtime, database, object storage, audit logs, monitoring, and secrets
connections.preferred: Least-privilege IAM role on AWS; ECS/Fargate, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager
connections.fallback: Run locally with encrypted configuration and file-backed ledger for the MVP
limitations: Do not deploy or operate the application with the AWS root identity
